verdict.rationale: A cites income-before-tax passages as causes of FY2023 revenue falls, and the international passage omits downstream margins. It presents the FY2023 tax rate as the prior-year base and links EPS to costs with a non sequitur. B uses correct prior-year baselines and shows the cyclical arc clearly.
